description: This file defines a React component for a driver dashboard page in a ride-hailing platform. It manages driver status, fetches driver data from API endpoints, and provides UI controls for toggling online/offline status and completing rides.

methods.name: DriverPage
methods.description: Main React component for driver dashboard, handling state, API interactions, and UI rendering.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches driver data from API and updates component state.

methods.name: goOnline
methods.description: Sets driver status to online via API and refreshes data.

methods.name: goOffline
methods.description: Sets driver status to offline via API and refreshes data.

methods.name: completeRide
methods.description: Marks the current ride as completed via API and refreshes data.
